posts.title: Seven months of AI later
posts.description: Seven months have passed since I last wrote a blog post here. Since then at least seven new AI models have been released, at least seven new sandboxes have been escaped from, and way more than seven annoying tasks have been handled for me by AI. But way more than seven things are also now bothering me about our current use of AI.

posts.title: Tailscale is great
posts.description: After reporting over 32 000 IP addresses for trying to hack my box, I decided to finally just shut off port 22, and migrate to Tailscale.

posts.title: My take on AI is changing
posts.description: Less than half a year ago I was not only skeptical towards AI in my field, software development, but also not very impressed by the results it produced at the time. Now, however, I rarely write code myself anymore, and I'm not really observing the problems I envisioned would arise by the increased use. But. Some concerns I had, I still have.
